title: Neural Isomorphic Fields: A Transformer-based Algebraic Numerical Embedding
abstract: arXiv:2601.12095v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural network models often face challenges when processing very small or very large numbers due to issues such as overflow, underflow, and unstable output variations. To mitigate these problems, we propose using embedding vectors for numbers instead of directly using their raw values. These embeddings aim to retain essential algebraic properties while preventing numerical instabilities. We introduce Neural Isomorphic Fields (NIF), a digit-sequence Transformer autoencoder trained with two learned commutative operators and an antisymmetric neural comparator. At zero loss, the embeddings provably form an ordered integral domain isomorphic to the decimal fractions, whose field of fractions is isomorphic to the rationals. For the trained model, we bound errors of operations, chains and algebraic laws by decoding margins, defects and Lipschitz constants. Trained on up to 25 digits, NIF reaches at least 99.9% exact match on closure,

translated_title: 神经同构域：一种基于Transformer的代数数值嵌入方法
translated_abstract: 神经网络模型在处理非常大或非常小的数字时常常面临挑战，原因在于溢出、下溢以及输出变化不稳定等问题。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出使用嵌入向量来表示数字，而不是直接使用其原始数值。这些嵌入旨在保留关键的代数性质，同时避免数值不稳定性。我们提出了神经同构域，这是一种数字序列Transformer自编码器，通过两个学习得到的交换算子和一个反对称神经比较器进行训练。在零损失条件下，这些嵌入可被证明构成一个与十进制分数同构的有序整环，其分式域与有理数同构。对于训练后的模型，我们通过解码边际、缺陷和Lipschitz常数来界定运算、链式运算和代数法则的误差。在最多25位数字上训练后，NIF在封闭性上达到了至少99.9%的精确匹配率。
tldr: 该论文提出神经同构域（NIF），一种基于Transformer的数字嵌入方法，可证明地保留十进制分数的代数结构（与有理数域同构），从而解决神经网络处理极端数值时的溢出与不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Neural Isomorphic Fields (NIF), a Transformer-based numerical embedding that provably preserves the algebraic structure of decimal fractions (isomorphic to the rationals), addressing overflow and instability issues when neural networks process extreme numerical values.
